name: DENEndLOINCConceptMap
title: DEN.End ConceptMap to LOINC
description: Candidate mappings from DEN.End local answer concepts to LOINC, transcribed from the source data dictionary without asserting exact equivalence.

text.div: Only targets supplied in the workbook are included. Candidate targets use relatedto pending terminology review; blank and not-classifiable cells have no target. The LOINC codes identify date-valued concepts, whereas the DEN.End answers are categorical closure reasons.

target.comment: Candidate transcribed from source row 3 (DEN.End). The workbook marks it Best fit. LOINC describes a date, not the categorical closure reason; retained as relatedto pending review.

target.display: Date lost to HIV treatment follow-up
target.comment: Candidate transcribed from source row 4 (DEN.End). The workbook marks it Best fit. LOINC describes a date and is specific to HIV treatment follow-up, not a general categorical closure reason; retained as relatedto pending review.
